The [Statistical Inference](inference.qmd) page defines the
[null hypothesis](inference.qmd#def-null-hypothesis),
the [alternative hypothesis](inference.qmd#def-alternative-hypothesis),
[test statistics](inference.qmd#def-test-statistic),
[p-values](inference.qmd#def-p-value),
and [significance levels](inference.qmd#def-significance-level).
In a comparison of two groups with means $\mean_1$ and $\mean_2$,
the null hypothesis is usually $H_0: \mean_1 = \mean_2$,
and the two-sided alternative is $H_1: \mean_1 \neq \mean_2$.
